description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sol Ring, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
